full_judgment:
Md Ashfaqul Islam J: At the instance of the petitioners who are the third parties, this Rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the exparte judgment and decree dated 1-8-99 and final decree dated 24-10-99 passed by the subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Narayangonj in Artha Rin Case No. 13 of 1998 and why the proceeding of Artha Rin Adalat Execution Case No. 43 of 2000 and Order No. 57 dated 31-10- 2007 passed by the Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat 1 Narayangonj in Artha Rin 1 Section Case No. 43 of 2000 issuing certificate under section 33(7) of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and Order No. 58 dated 3-1-2008 passed by the Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat Narayangonj in Artha Rin Execution Case No. 43 of 2000 disposing of the Execution should not be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 2. The background leading to the Rule in short, is that the petitioners of the instant case wits not a party in the said Artha Rin Suit and Artha Execution Case and after receiving the notice dated 13-1-2011 of Misc. Case No. 499 of 2010 the petitioners made personal written representation on 24- 4-2011 to release the petitioners land after realizing decreetal amount but no reply was received from the respondents Nos. 3 and 4 and thereafter the petitioner sent a notice demanding justice on 5-5-2011 through their Advocate, where it was mentioned that the petitioners were bonafide purchaser and the property measuring 37.50 decimals of land (Schedule Ka of the Plaint of Artha Rin Suit No. 13 of 1998) was in their possession and that the petitioners were also ready to pay decreetal amount against their scheduled land. In reply to the said notice the respendent No. 3 sent a reply on 22-5-2011 through their Advocate where the respondent No. 3 denied all the allegation and stated that the property in question had already been sold on 20-6-2010 and also mentioned that no mutation Misc. Case was pending and the property had already been duly mutated in the name of the bank. 

 3. Consequent to a exparte decree dated 1-8- 99 the execution case followed and in the year 2008 by Order No. 58 dated 3-1-2008 the said execution case was disposed of with the issuing of the certificate under section 33(7) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003. As it has been already mentioned that the petitioners are the third party and their case is that they are the bonafide purchaser of the mortgage property and they are willing to clear up the outstanding dues of the bank. But the Fact remains that the petitioners in this regard can have their remedy under section 32 of the Ain, 2003, if so advised. We would like to add further that the petitioner if so advised can take recourse to section 32 of the Ain and in that event the Court shall dispose of the case as expeditiously as possible preferably within 2 (two) months from the receipt of this Order.
